- `rasp.Select(rasp.indices, rasp.indices, rasp.Comparison.TRUE)`  
  This selector is all True (selects all positions for every position).
- `rasp.SelectorWidth(...)` will then return the length for every position.

- So, for each position i, we want to select the token at position `n - 1 - i`.
- So, `opp_idx = length - 1 - rasp.indices`
